method: requested display transform: round(abs(raw sound_dbfs), 1) with no percentage reduction; raw dBFS unchanged; not a traceable SPL calibration

temperature_method: displayed °C = raw SHT3x-DIS °C + 0.2 °C; based on one simultaneous field pair (dashboard 18.2 °C, reference meter 18.4 °C); raw reading retained unchanged
humidity_method: displayed %RH = raw SHT3x-DIS %RH - 7.0 percentage points; previous displayed value 65.0 %RH already included a -3.0 point bias, so the simultaneous 61.0 %RH reference adds -4.0 points; raw reading retained unchanged

temperature_humidity_field_reference.method: single-point co-location comparison; provisional until verified with synchronized multi-point readings after equilibration
